name: CallStackGet
description: Returns the context (stacktrace) of the current position.

params.name: type
params.description:
the type of the returned value, possible values are:

- array
- string
- html
- json

params.name: offset
params.description: the number of frames to skip, default is 0

params.name: maxFrames
params.description: the maximum number of frames to return, default is 0 which means all
